new_insert_email_body.text:
Hi Emma,

Could you review the London hotels and pick the one whose guest reviews specifically mention a view of the River Thames? Once you've identified it, please reserve it for May 28 to 30, 2024. After booking, just let me know—I'll feel a lot better once it's sorted.

Mark
